_comment: Preguntas ORIGINALES tipo NIE del capítulo 2.14. No son preguntas reales del examen. Comprueba con tu edición 2027.

questions.scenario: Under s. 2A RTA 1988, driving is dangerous if it falls…
options: Far below what would be expected of a competent and careful driver, and it would be obvious to such a driver that driving that way would be dangerous
Below the standard of a competent and careful driver

questions.scenario: Careless driving is driving that falls…
options: Below what would be expected of a competent and careful driver

questions.scenario: A driver deliberately drives through a puddle to soak a bus queue. Which offence?
options: Inconsiderate driving (without reasonable consideration for other persons)

questions.scenario: For inconsiderate driving, the other persons must have been…
Can a car be driven 'dangerously' because of its current state (e.g. no brakes)?
options: Yes – if it would be obvious to a competent and careful driver that driving it in that state is dangerous
explanations: Objective test (but knowledge of circumstances counts).

questions.scenario: 'Dangerous' in s. 2A refers to danger of…
options: Injury to any person or serious damage to property

questions.scenario: Since the PCSCA 2022, what is the maximum penalty for causing death by dangerous driving (⚠)?
Which offence did the PCSCA 2022 create (⚠)?
options: Causing serious injury by careless or inconsiderate driving (s. 2C)

questions.scenario: 'Serious injury' for s. 1A and s. 2C means…
options: Physical harm amounting to grievous bodily harm

questions.scenario: An uninsured driver, driving perfectly, hits a pedestrian who ran into the road and dies. Following R v Hughes, is it s. 3ZB?
options: No – there must be some fault in his driving contributing to the death

questions.scenario: Which offence covers causing death by careless driving while over the drink-drive limit?
Within how many days must a NIP normally be served?
On whom can a NIP be served?
options: The driver or the registered keeper

questions.scenario: When is a NIP NOT required?
options: When an accident occurred owing to the presence of the vehicle on a road at the time or immediately after
When the driver is a woman

questions.scenario: A driver was warned at the roadside that he would be reported for careless driving. Is a NIP still needed?
options: No – a warning at the time satisfies s. 1

questions.scenario: Under s. 170, if the driver didn't give his details at the scene, he must report the accident…
options: As soon as reasonably practicable and in any case within 24 hours

questions.scenario: Which animal is NOT listed in s. 170?
Where can dangerous and careless driving be committed?
options: On a road or other public place

questions.scenario: Is the test for dangerous driving objective or subjective?
options: Objective – the competent and careful driver, though circumstances shown to be within D's knowledge count

questions.scenario: Two drivers race at 90 mph through a 30 mph town centre. Which offence?
What is the maximum penalty for causing death by driving while disqualified (s. 3ZC ⚠)?
